turns.question: Where is application-level route handling wired up, and is the router itself implemented inside this repository?
turns.text:
Confirmed: `router` is an external npm dependency (`"router": "^2.2.0"`), not implemented in this repo. Now checking how application.js wires it up.I have enough evidence. Submitting the report.
